title: Evaluation of a tree conversion
statement: Let $T$ be a coordinate decision tree on the Boolean cube $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, with values in a type $\alpha$, and let $A$ be a set of available coordinates. If every query made by $T$ uses a coordinate in $A$ and each child tree satisfies the same condition after that coordinate is removed, then converting $T$ to a decision tree whose queries explicitly track available coordinates preserves its evaluation at every input in $\mathbb{F}_2^n$.
hypotheses_covered: T is a coordinate decision tree on n coordinates with values in α
A is a finite set of coordinates
T is well formed with respect to A
